verses.1: A poem about the house of David’s reign.
verses.2: O LORD, why have you forsaken me? Why have you not rejoiced with my friends?
verses.3: Yehova, my God, you have healed me. You have saved me from my ailments.
verses.4: YHWH, You have raised me from the dead. You have given me life again.
verses.5: Praise Jehovah, his saints; honor him, for he is holy.
verses.6: For a moment, they live in their desires during the day; in the evening, they become weak.
verses.7: And I said in triumph, “For ever and ever.”
verses.8: Yehova, in your desire, you stood before me. You hid your face from me; I was terrified.
verses.9: I will cry out to the LORD, and I will pray to the God of my ancestors.
verses.10: What is the meaning of this verse in Biblical Hebrew? It seems to say: “In my distress, when I went to your place, you were like a tree that gives fruit.”
verses.11: Hear, O LORD; save me, O LORD! May You be my savior.
verses.12: You have turned me from a sad person into a happy one. You have opened my heart, and you have made me joyful.
verses.13: So that You may be honored, and that the Lord God may not curse You forever.
